leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a portal host component to define where dynamic content will be rendered.
Configure a portal service to manage the creation and attachment of portal content.
Construct a portal directive to mark template content as a portal source.
Initialize and attach portal content to a designated portal outlet.
Manipulate portal content dynamically by detaching and reattaching it based on user interaction.
Integrate portal functionality into a component to enable dynamic UI updates.
Apply portal concepts to render template content in a different part of the DOM than its declaration.
